name: std::ranges::chunk_view<V>::end

declarations.code:
constexpr auto end() const
    requires ranges::forward_range<const V>;

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator or sentinel representing the end of the chunk_view, as described above.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a chunk_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns an iterator or a std::default_sentinel that compares equal to the end iterator of the chunk_view.
